roads.name: Pasqua Lake Road
words: Properly twisty: 12 curves in 2.1 miles, about 6 a mile.
From 1,579 to 1,646 ft, with 262 ft of up and down along the way.
Homes line much of it: about 47 buildings a mile beside the road.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 60 km/h limit its corners still ask for about 0.34 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.
